fixed_log_model.definition: Z(s)=ln(C(s)/(1 mg/kg)) describes latent standard-composite concentration at the center of a support comparable to the original approximate15m by15m sampling composites. Mean6; Cov(Z(s),Z(t))=.5*exp(-Euclidean_distance(s,t)/180m). Training log assays observe Z(s)+independent zero-mean Gaussian noise of variance .04. All latent fields and assay errors are jointly Gaussian; errors independent of latent field. These fixed assumed values are not estimated from the12records.

data.support_protocol: Meuse source concentrations came from approximately15m by15m composite samples. Here the latent model is explicitly over comparable composite-support values indexed by centers, not point soil concentrations or a point-field kernel integrated over an area. Each future composite has the same approximate support and equal dry mass within its named pool. Target assay noise is not part of the latent concentration prediction. Pool concentration is the arithmetic mean of the four original-scale latent concentrations, not exp(mean log concentration). No continuous-area block average or whole-site exposure is requested.
data.cohort_protocol: Use the first12records in the original Meuse source row order, preserving original row names and every positive zinc concentration. This predeclared bounded study cohort is not selected by zinc outcome or target distance. The complete155record source is retained separately for provenance, not additional training data.
data.coordinate_protocol: x and y use the same Netherlands RDH metric map coordinate system as the original Meuse data; use Euclidean distance in metres. Prospective target centers are project-authored, not historical Meuse sample positions. Target order is target_pools order then target_composites order; retain the full conditional joint covariance across targets. Independent assay errors do not make latent spatial predictions independent.
data.requested_probability_scope: Compute moments of each equal-mass pooled latent original-scale concentration conditional on all12observed training assays and the fixed model. Report the conditional standard deviation, not training residual spread, standard error of a mean under a different model, or a Gaussian/lognormal confidence interval for a sum. No empirical calibration or real-site contamination classification claim.

source_provenance.kind: original source observations with separately declared fixed model and prospective composite targets
source_provenance.read_scope: Official archive sp/man/meuse.Rd:155observations, map-coordinate and concentration units, approximately15m by15m composite supports, original collectors and compiled source. No claim to have read or replicated the original1993Utrechtfield report. GPMLChapter2Section2.2Eqs2.18–2.26 and Algorithm2.1: noisy-training/latent-target Gaussian conditioning and joint covariance; no claim that fixed kernel/hyperparameters here were fitted or externally validated.
